questions.question: If the areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box are 729 cm², 529 cm², and 289 cm² respectively, then find the volume of the box.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Areas of 3 adjacent faces, 

729 cm2, 529 cm2, and 289 cm2 

**Concept Used:**

Area of single cuboidal face = l × b,

Volume of Cuboid = l × b × h 

where l is the length, b is the breadth, and h is the height.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/897d8480061989755bf70e42825377ebcb01c40dd61b9ba637715095ecd4a0af.png] 

According to the question, 

 l × b = 729

b × h = 529

h × l = 289

Multiplying all three results, we will get

⇒ l × b × b × h × h × l = 729 × 529 × 289 

⇒ l² × b² × h² = 729 × 529 × 289 

Taking square root on both sides, 

⇒ l × b × h = {sqrt{729 × 529 × 289}} 

⇒ l × b × h = 10,557

**∴ The volume of a cuboid is 10,557 cm³. **

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 3?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers which is divisible by 3

**Concept Used:**

Divisibility Test of 3 = Sum of all digits of a number to be divisible by 3

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits of 7865001 = 7 + 8 + 6 + 5 + 0 + 0 + 1 = 27

⇒ So, 27 is divisible by 3

⇒ Sum of digits of 7803572 = 7 + 8 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 2 = 32

⇒ So, 32 is not divisible by 3

⇒ Sum of digits of 7803541 = 7 + 8 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 1 = 28

⇒ So, 28 is not divisible by 3

⇒ Sum of digits of 7803593 = 7 + 8 + 0 + 3 + 5 + 9 + 3 = 35

⇒ So, 35 is not divisible by 3

**Hence, the number which is divisible by 3 is 7865001**

questions.question: When the price of an article was reduced by 25%, its sale was increased by 75%. Calculate the net effect on revenue.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price of article reduction = 25%

Sale of article increment = 75%

**Concept Used:**

Net effect on revenue = Increment in sale – Reduction percentage in Price – ((Increment in sale × Reduction Percentage in price) ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Putting the values in the formula,

⇒ Net effect on revenue = 75-25-(75×25)/(100) %

⇒ Net effect on revenue = 50-(75)/(4) %

⇒ Net effect on revenue = 50-18.75=31.25 %

⇒ As the net effect result is in positive sign, then there is an increment.

**Hence, the net effect on revenue is increase with 31.25 %**

questions.question: The average of 25 numbers is 18. The average of the first 12 of these numbers is 14 and that of the last 12 of these numbers is 17. The 13th number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 25 numbers = 18

Average of first 12 numbers = 14

Average of last 12 numbers = 17

**Concept Used:**

Average = Sum of numbers ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sum of 25 numbers = 25 × 18 = 450

⇒ Average of first 12 numbers = 14

⇒ So, sum of first 12 numbers = 14 × 12 = 168

⇒ Average of last 12 numbers = 17

⇒ So, sum of last 12 numbers = 17 × 12 = 204

⇒ Value of the 13th number = 450 – (168 + 204) = 450 – 372

⇒ Value of the 13th number = 78

**Hence, the value of the 13th number is 78**

Total Students = Ratio × Number of students using any one vehicle

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number of students using school bus, bike and bicycle be 6x, 3x and x respectively.

⇒ 6x+3x+x=1200

⇒ 10x=1200

⇒ x=120

⇒ Number of students who use bicycle for transport = x = 120

**Hence, the number of students who use bicycle for transport is 120**

questions.question: The value of the expression 1800 ÷ 10{(18 - 6) + [-2(1 + 2 )]} is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the nested terms from inside out: (1 + 2) = 3 and (18 − 6) = 12.

The middle term becomes [−2 × 3] = −6.

The brace term becomes {12 + (−6)} = 6.

The expression reduces to 1800 ÷ 10{6}, which is 1800 ÷ 60.

Calculation: 1800 ÷ 60 = 30.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 1800 ÷ 10{(18 − 6) + [−2(1 + 2)]}

Formula: VBODMAS (Vinculum, Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{(12) + [−2(3)]}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{12 + (−6)}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{12 − 6}

⇒ 1800 ÷ 10{6}

⇒ 1800 ÷ (10 × 6)

⇒ 1800 ÷ 60

⇒ 30

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

VBODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence for solving mathematical operations: Vinculum → Brackets → Of → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction.

Bracket Priority

Always solve in the order of: circular brackets ( ), then curly braces { }, and finally square brackets [ ].

Implicit Multiplication

In many competitive exams, a number adjacent to a bracket (juxtaposition) is treated as a priority operation, similar to the Of (O) step.</p

questions.question:
Study the following pie-chart carefully, which shows a state government's expenditure (% allocation) on various sectors during the year 2019.

If ₹27 million were spent on transport in 2019, what would have been the total expenses (in million) of the given state government in that year considering mentioned sectors only?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8ea7a7585bb066f7977cbaca86d9e3b047a1f9cdd7f63c77b7e31cf63e9423d.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Spent on transport in 2019 = Rs 27 million

Expenses share of transport = 18%

Expenses share of agriculture = 30%

Expenses share of health = 15%

Expenses share of irrigation = 25%

Expenses share of dairy = 12%

**Concept Used:**

Total composition of each sector = Percentage Expenses × Amount in one percent

**Calculation:**

⇒ 18% of transport expenses contain = Rs 27 million = Rs 27,000,000

⇒ 1% of the expenses include = (27000000)/(18)=1,500,000

⇒ Now, Expenses share of agriculture = 30 times 1500000=45,000,000

⇒ Expenses share of health = 15×1500000=22,500,000

⇒ Expenses share of irrigation = 25×1500000=37,500,000

⇒ Expenses share of dairy = 1500000×12=18,000,000

⇒ Total Expenses of all sectors = 27,000,000 + 45,000,000 + 22,500,000 + 37,500,000 + 18,000,000

⇒ Total Expenses of all sectors = Rs 150,000,000

**Hence, the total expenses (in million) of the given sectors in the state government is 150 million.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** From the pie chart,

Expense on transport = 18%

18% = 27 M

Then total expense = 100% = (27/18) * 100 = **150 M**

questions.question: In a class there are 26 boys and 24 girls. The Math teacher administered a test and found that the average score of the whole class is 85. If the average score of the boys was 82, find the average score of the girls.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of boys in class = 26

Number of girls in class = 24

Average score of whole class = 85

Average score of boys = 82

**Concept Used:**

Average = Total Sum of Values ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **Let the total marks scored by whole class be x

⇒ Average score of class = (x)/(26+24)=(x)/(50) 

⇒ x= 50×85=4250

⇒ Let the total marks scored by boys be y

⇒ Average score of boys = (y)/(26)

⇒ y=26×82=2132

⇒ Marks scored by girls = 4250 – 2132 = 2118

⇒ Average score by girls = (2118)/(24)=88.25 

**Hence, the average marks scored by the girls is 88.25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

alligation method:-

⇒ (85 - 82)/(x - 85) = 24/26 

⇒ 3/(x - 85) = 12/13

⇒12x - 12 × 85 = 39 

⇒ 12x - 1020 = 39 

⇒ 12x = 1059 

⇒ x = 88.25

questions.question: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 80 cm. If the side that is not equal in length to any of the other two sides is 20 cm, find the length of each of the equal sides.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Perimeter = 80 cm.

length of an unequal side = 20 cm.

**FORMULA USED:**

P = 2a + b units. Where P = Perimeter, a = length of two equal sides. and b = length of base or unequal side.

**CALCULATION:**

Here P = 80 cm , b = 20 cm 

⇒P = 2a + b 

⇒ 80 = 2a + 20 

⇒2a = 60 

⇒ a = 30 cm.

**Hence, Length of each of the equal sides is 30 cm.**

questions.question: A number is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 10%. If the resulting number is 72, what is the original number?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

resulting number = 72

**FORMULA USED:**

Successive percentage change = X - Y -X Y /100 Where X and Y are percentage increase and decrease respectively

**CALCULATION:**

Let the original number be x

Here, X = 25 % increase , Y = 10% decrease 

Successive % change = 25 - 10 -( 25×10/100 )= + 12.5% ( +) sign shows increase.

⇒ x + 12.5%x = 72.

⇒ x + (125)/(1000)x =72.

⇒ x +(1)/(8) x = 72. ⇔ 9x/8 = 72 ⇔ x = 64.

**Hence, the original number is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let the original number = x 

According to the question,

⇒ x × (125/100) × (90/100) = 72

⇒ x × (5/4) × (9/10) = 72

⇒ x × 45/40 = 72

⇒ x = 72 × 40/45

⇒ x = 64

Hence, the original number is 64.

questions.question: A boat’s speed in still water is 22 km/h, while the river is flowing with a speed of 8 km/h and the time taken to cover a certain distance upstream is 4 hours more than the time taken to cover the same distance downstream. Find the distance.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed = 22 + 8 = 30 km/h

Upstream speed = 22 − 8 = 14 km/h

Distance = [(Product of speeds) ÷ (Difference of speeds)] × Time Difference

Distance = [(30 × 14) ÷ (30 − 14)] × 4

Distance = (420 ÷ 16) × 4 = 105 km

**∴ The correct answer is 105 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water = 22 km/h

Speed of the river = 8 km/h

Difference in time taken = 4 hours

 

 

 
• 
 
• 
 Total Distance = D
 
• 
 
 Downstream: 30 km/h (T hrs)
 

 
 Upstream: 14 km/h (T + 4 hrs)
 

**Formula Used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of boat + Speed of river

Speed upstream = Speed of boat − Speed of river

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed downstream = 22 + 8 = 30 km/h

⇒ Speed upstream = 22 − 8 = 14 km/h

Let the total distance be D.

⇒ Time taken upstream = D ÷ 14

⇒ Time taken downstream = D ÷ 30

According to the given condition:

⇒ (D ÷ 14) − (D ÷ 30) = 4

Taking LCM of 14 and 30, which is 210:

⇒ (15D − 7D) ÷ 210 = 4

⇒ 8D ÷ 210 = 4

⇒ 8D = 4 × 210

⇒ 8D = 840

⇒ D = 840 ÷ 8 = 105 km

**∴ The correct answer is 105 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speeds in Water

If the boat's speed is u and the stream's speed is v, then Downstream Speed = u + v, and Upstream Speed = u − v.

Finding Speeds from Upstream & Downstream

Boat's speed in still water = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2. Stream's speed = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for a Round Trip

When traveling distance D downstream and returning upstream, Average Speed = (2 × Downstream Speed × Upstream Speed) ÷ (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed).
</p
